scope: Proposition 7.8 of the manuscript “Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions” (preprints/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d50937326c7cb115), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let a = aK,Y + M be a Calabi–Yau presentation, sub-generalized klt over the generic point of V and effective in horizontal trace. If M is b-semiample or b-nef and big, then π#a = aK,V + N for a b-nef b-Q-Cartier divisor N. Positive rational scaling and translation by base Cartier pullbacks give the corresponding presentations with their scaled canonical coefficient and prescribed total divisor.
